text: Response: The new bill (HR 4758) on which the current draft of the Environmental Impact Statement is based does not except Aleuts, Eskimos, and American Indians from provisions of the proposed legislation. Therefore, there can be adverse effects on these peoples from enforcement of provisions of the legislation. We cannot agree with EDF that restriction of man's use of endangered species habitat is not an adverse effect. Theoretically, "with freedom also comes responsibility," but in the case of many species, man's use of habitat is not compatible with production of endangered species under any circumstances and this restriction will be adverse to someone. "Responsibility" in this case may mean something different to each person.
